title: blob_download_handler doc comment claims ?accept= is used but code ignores it
description:
What is unclear: the doc comment at the top of blob_download_handler (kithd/src/lib.rs ~line 165) says 'Content-Type is taken from the optional ?accept=... query parameter (max 256 bytes; must contain /).' The implementation does NOT extract or use ?accept=. Content-Type is always taken from the attachments table (or falls back to application/octet-stream). The comment is accurate about the fallback behavior but incorrectly describes ?accept= as the source. A contributor reading this comment would expect a query parameter extraction that doesn't exist, and might add a broken one.

Fix: update the comment to accurately describe the DB-sourced content-type behavior. A note explaining why ?accept= is deliberately ignored (prevents stored-XSS) should be kept — it already appears in an inline comment, but the doc-comment should match.
